Method of Attack: Compromised download links pointing off-site to malicious versions of the original phpBB files containing additional malicious code
Malicious code attempts to load JavaScript from a remote source
Attack Vector: Compromise of a third-party site hosting download links
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious download links live for 181 minutes on January 26
Malicious packages downloaded by less than 500 users
Malicious code loading JavaScript from remote source controlled by phpBB team
